5090.title: Desktop clipboard verification
5090.rootCauseOneLine: Root cause unconfirmed: source helpers await browser writes, but native clipboard reproduction is blocked before Electron application code by missing Linux runtime prerequisites.
5090.proposedFix: Reproduce on an isolated graphical source desktop and compare renderer write outcomes with the native clipboard before selecting a regression and root-cause fix.
5090.caveats: Two clean checkouts passed 206 relevant mocked-boundary tests each; native preflight failed identically in both. This does not refute the report or establish that the bug is fixed. No safe PR without a reproduced defect and failing regression.
